title: Don't Save The Date
overview: Meshi, a barista from Tel Aviv who likes to mess around, has a great habit of avoiding responsibility. He promises his best friend to organize the most luxurious bachelor party ever - and then completely forgets about it. When the day of the party arrives and the obsessive bride hands off the groom to him with very detailed operating instructions, Meshi realizes the severity of the problem he set himself into. With no other choice, he starts planning the event on the go. Soon enough, things get out of control. Between nonstop moments of insanity and some moments of simple truth, Meshi discovers that he might not have been "on it" as he believed.

title: The Parallel World: The rift
overview: After a boy enters a dangerous parallel world, he begins to realize that a powerful sorcerer in this realm threatens to destroy reality itself—and that the sorcerer will stop at nothing to achieve this, killing anyone who stands in his way.

title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
